name: Garden of Oblivion
source:
One day Reven awakens in a strange but beautiful place where the young teenager is treated like a very special guest. There are talking animals, each being rather kind and friendly. Unless the door is mentioned. The one in the back of the garden. But what could be behind that mysterious door? And why Reven isn't allowed to go out? You shouldn't try to know the truth... 

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=39080]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/08/20/welcome-to-ludum-dare-30/]Ludum Dare 30[/url] (theme: Connected Worlds).
translation:
一天，雷文在一个奇异却美丽的地方醒来，年幼的她被当作贵宾招待。会说话的动物们友善而亲切，除非有人提到花园后方那扇门。那扇神秘的门后究竟有什么？雷文又为何不被允许离开？你不该试图了解真相……

[译自[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=39080]Ludum Dare[/url]]

本作为[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/08/20/welcome-to-ludum-dare-30/]Ludum Dare 30[/url]制作（主题：连接的世界）。
